segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Intouch Triangle T a T b T c—also called the Contact Triangle—and the Extouch Triangle E a E b E c record where the incircle and excircles touch the sidelines of triangle A B C.

segments.text: By Ceva's theorem, the cevians to the three incircle touch points concur at the Gergonne Point X seven, making the intouch triangle both the pedal triangle of X one and the cevian triangle of X seven. The cevians to the three excircle touch points concur at the Nagel Point X eight, making the extouch triangle the cevian triangle of X eight.

segments.text: Because each intouch vertex and extouch vertex are equidistant from the opposite ends of their side, the intouch and extouch triangles are isotomic duals, and X seven and X eight are isotomic conjugates.
